name: app-dark-finance-dashboard-over-green-hills-with-donut-and-bar-charts
title: Dark banking dashboard floating over a soft-focus green hillside with a lilac donut and stacked capsule bars
whatItIs: A dark desktop dashboard with a left icon rail, an Overview heading, a bank card and four stat columns, a Quick Transfer row of avatars, an expenses chart of capsule-shaped bars in blue, lilac and mint, and a right column with a lilac donut with $13,456.29 and a recent transactions list, over a blurred green landscape photo.
whatItMeans: Calm and premium; dark glass panels over a natural photo soften data.
techniques: Float a dark dashboard over a landscape photo.
Use a lilac donut for the balance.

vocabulary.definition: A bar with fully rounded ends.
